route.semantics: full replacement; name/category required; description/config/schedule replace only when supplied

authority.service: current User re-read; active status; WORKSPACE_ADMIN+; claim is_active/status/role/raw tenant/raw workspace in the replacement transaction
authority.scope_policy: foreign tenant/workspace 404; workspace-bound below ADMIN only same/legacy workspace; ADMIN+ may cross workspaces in tenant; unscoped platform actor keeps global-legacy policy

material.sensitive_material: no raw configuration, schedule or secret in the receipt or logs

effect.write: guarded AgentRegistry update on the exact prior material
effect.receipt: one AuditLog action=agent_replaced in the same transaction
effect.readback: fresh session; current state digest must match the result digest
effect.scheduler: only after a verified commit; once; never on replay/no-change
effect.states: verified; no_change; already_applied; refused 404/403/422; conflict 409 STALE_TARGET/AUTHORITY_CHANGED/OPERATION_CONFLICT; not_applied 409; committed_unverified 503

parallel_writers.registration/update/promote/delete/run: same-service exact-material claims detect concurrent changes
parallel_writers.scheduler: post-commit effect; failure logged after the committed DB effect
